description: Browse and filter CERN Open Data collision and simulated datasets by experiment, publication year, collision energy, and keyword. Returns only records of type Dataset (66,000+ datasets). Useful for finding specific NanoAOD or MiniAOD simulation samples, real collision data, or derived datasets for a given LHC run period. LHC Run 1 data: 2010–2012 at 7–8 TeV; Run 2 data: 2015–2016 at 13 TeV. Experiments: CMS (57K+), ALICE (171), ATLAS (184), LHCb (7K+), DELPHI (12K+). Supports pagination for large result sets.

collision_energy.description: Filter by collision energy (e.g. "13TeV", "8TeV", "7TeV"). Run 2 used 13 TeV, Run 1 used 7–8 TeV.

experiment.description: Filter by CERN experiment. CMS has 57K+ datasets, LHCb has 7K+, DELPHI has 12K+.

limit.description: Number of datasets to return (1–25, default 10)

year.description: Filter by publication year (e.g. "2015", "2016", "2012"). LHC Run 1: 2010–2013, Run 2: 2015–2016.

name: cernopendata.datasets.browse

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CERN Open Data Datasets Browser
